performance.gateMetric: Generate/load request to accepted scene, matching the original Escarpment loading baseline. Engine startup and verification instrumentation are reported separately.
performance.protocol: One first process and five warm new-process repetitions per variant/mode; alternating executable order; same machine,2560x1440,60FPS cap; no simultaneous local compilation, native tests or second game. OS/driver caches were not flushed.

metadata.timing: Process launch through accepted moving-playback event; native callback, mesh preparation, scene commit and ready timings are retained separately.
metadata.samples: One cold sample and exactly warm_runs warm samples per executable; warm summaries report median and maximum only. No p95 is inferred from five samples.
metadata.cache: Each repetition uses a new process. The first is reported separately; OS and driver caches are not forcibly cleared, so cold means first process in this experiment, not an empty machine cache.

runtime.scope: Full rear traversal without screenshot readback on RTX5070Ti/D3D12 at2560x1440 and a60FPS cap. Front captures are reviewed separately.

serialization.scope: Independent observations of the unchanged accepted-revision serializer, not a five-run serialization benchmark.

modelingAssumptions: Scoped ASTM F2291-25 acceleration assessment for the documented upright Class4/5 restraint, lower-body containment, backrest and headrest model.
Six1500kg cars,3.4m spacing,1.2m seat height, finite-train gravity/drive energy and the documented aerodynamic/rolling model.
Five-second saved-readiness gate is request-to-scene in the running application. Full process launch through verified first motion is measured separately.
Phase timings are main-thread wall intervals; independent validation work overlaps those intervals.
remainingLimitations: No F2291-26 conformity, whole-standard certification, manufacturer calibration or subjective ride-feel guarantee.
Full-process launch through instrumented first motion has a5.38s warm loading median; the in-app load gate passes at3.79s.
The0.9 flat control generates faster:7.88s versus8.73s. Its ride and validation scope differ from the final generator.
Representative nondefault requests can require rejected candidates; the CI higher-speed case took45.28s. This is not an all-seed16s guarantee.
Detailed terrain/art work, full GUI layout editing and VR remain later stages; the terrain uses a shared8m collision/render grid.
OS keyboard input was not driven directly; input contracts and actual runtime actions passed.
Exact FF wave dimensions and a manufacturer-calibrated FF rear trace remain unavailable.

visualReview.rearComparison: Rift rear captures review the same canonical ride; final default rear completed the actual GPU traversal and canonical pose checks without screenshot stalls.
notes: Opening crest, descending bank and low recovery are visible.
Connected broad terrain and low return are visible.
Loading phase, elapsed time, activity feedback and retained-ride guidance are readable.
